chronicle.beyondsolo.secret.hint: A hidden title. The System will tell you what it was once you have earned it.

chronicle.beyondsolo.deed: Earned by a deed of its own
chronicle.beyondsolo.acquired.wear: Wear it from the CHRONICLE page
title.beyondsolo.gravewarden.desc: Put 100 of the undead back to rest.
title.beyondsolo.ascended_bane.desc: Defeat 5 bosses in their ascended form.
title.beyondsolo.giant_slayer.desc: Slay a creature whose name burns red: one far stronger than you.
title.beyondsolo.one_who_endured.desc: Defeat a boss with less than 15% of your health left.
title.beyondsolo.rises_again.desc: Fall 10 times, and get back up every time.
title.beyondsolo.red_gate_survivor.desc: Come back alive from a red gate.
title.beyondsolo.nightwalker.desc: Live through 10 nights of the Red Winter.
title.beyondsolo.redgate_breaker.desc: Defeat the master of 5 red gates.
title.beyondsolo.chainrunner.desc: Clear 5 key runs in a single chain.
title.beyondsolo.seeker.desc: Find 5 hidden rooms in the gates.
title.beyondsolo.citadel_climber.desc: Reach floor 10 of the Crimson Citadel.
title.beyondsolo.halfway_to_the_throne.d: Reach floor 50 of the Crimson Citadel.
title.beyondsolo.citadel_conqueror.desc: Defeat the lord of the Crimson Citadel on its hundredth floor.
title.beyondsolo.spire_walker.desc: Reach floor 25 of the Endless Spire.
title.beyondsolo.the_endless.desc: Reach floor 100 of the Endless Spire.
title.beyondsolo.relentless.desc: Complete the System's quest Trial of the Depths.
title.beyondsolo.arbiter_slayer.desc: Slay the Hollow Arbiter in the sealed temple.
title.beyondsolo.archivist.desc: Fill in 40 pages of the journal.
title.beyondsolo.keeper_of_lore.desc: Fill in 100 pages of the journal.
chronicle.beyondsolo.rankings.no_time: No time in this tier yet. Finish its boss rush to be ranked.
chronicle.beyondsolo.rankings.loading: Asking the System for the rankings...
chronicle.beyondsolo.rankings.empty: No hunters on this board yet.
notify.beyondsolo.rankings.title: Rank #%s among hunters
notify.beyondsolo.rankings.first: No hunter in the world stands above you.
chronicle.beyondsolo.journal.hint.creatu: Not seen yet. Meet one in a gate and the System will fill in this page.
chronicle.beyondsolo.journal.hint.bosses: Not seen yet. Face it at the end of a gate to fill in this page.
chronicle.beyondsolo.journal.hint.realms: Not entered yet. Go through a gate that leads here.
chronicle.beyondsolo.journal.hint.arsena: Not held yet. Find this weapon and carry it.
chronicle.beyondsolo.journal.hint.slay: Seen, but not slain yet. Defeat one to learn more of it.
chronicle.beyondsolo.journal.no_lore: The System has nothing more to say about it.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.gloo: A hound of the gloom that hunts in packs, circling until one of them finds an opening. Its eyes are the last of it to fade into the dark.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.rime: A great cat furred with frost. It stalks out of the cold, strikes once, and is gone before the chill of its passing settles.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.pit_: Bred in the deepest pits of a gate. It charges anything that moves and does not stop for walls.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.dusk: A leathery flyer that drops from the dark ceiling of a gate, strikes, and climbs back out of reach.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.coil: A serpent that coils in the stone and strikes from farther away than it looks. Its venom lingers long after the bite.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.broo: The young of the hive's mother. Alone they are weak. They are never alone.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.shar: Its back is a ridge of crystal shards, harder than most blades. Strike where the shell parts.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.hive: A winged drone of the hive. It carries the swarm's will, and its sting.
The hive's soldier, all blades and armor. Where the reavers walk, the drones follow.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.crag: A crawler of the cavern walls, so like the rock that hunters walk right past it.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.grav: A corpse the gate will not let rest. Cut it down once and it rises again. Cut it down twice.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.bone: Long dead, it still remembers the bow. It keeps its distance and rarely misses twice.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.wail: A spirit of grief that drifts through the walls. Its cry chills the blood of whoever hears it.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.holl: A robed servant of something deep inside the gate, chanting in a tongue no hunter has learned.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.ashe: A guard of ash and iron that keeps its post long after whoever set it there is gone.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.gutt: Small, quick and filthy. Gutterkin swarm the weak, flee the strong, and steal whatever shines.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.rime: A hunter of the frozen gates who wears the cold like a cloak and strikes out of the blizzard.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.tusk: A tusked giant that fights with whatever it can lift. It feels pain late, and rarely.
The tusked tribe's caster. It mends its kin and curses its foes. Strike it first.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.deep: Something that crawled up out of the drowned halls, still wet with water that never saw the sun.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.embe: A living ember that drifts on the air and bursts into flame when it comes too close.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.stat: A knot of lightning that wanders the gates and leaps to anything made of metal.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.brim: A small, cackling thing of sulfur and fire that throws flame and laughs at the burns.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.rune: A giant of stone carved with runes that glow when it wakes. Whoever made it is long gone.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.creatures.thor: A rooted plant that spits thorns at anything it hears. It cannot follow you, so do not stand still.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.brute: The great brutes of the gates grow with the rank of the gate: a hollow thing in the lowest, an overlord drenched in crimson in the highest. All of them hit like a falling wall.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.broodmo: Mother of every broodling, she guards the heart of her nest in silk and venom. Kill the young before they bury you.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.alpha: Leader of the frost wolves. Its howl calls the pack, and the cold follows its breath.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.knight: A knight in hollow armor, still keeping an oath to a king who never was. Its blade remembers every duel.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.magus: A masked caster of storms. It never shows its face, and the thunder answers its hand.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.wyrm: A drake of ash and cinders that rules the burning gates. Its breath turns stone to glass.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.arbiter: The guardian of the sealed temple, who judges whoever enters. It knelt for ages, waiting for someone worth judging.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.bosses.citadel: The Crimson King sits on his throne above a hundred floors, and every gatekeeper below answers to him.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.hollows: A burrow of packed earth and stone, the first gate most hunters ever see. Even here, something is always watching.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.mirewoo: Caverns rotten with swamp and twisted roots. The air is thick with poison, and the water is never as shallow as it looks.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.azure_g: A grotto of blue water and ice, beautiful and freezing. The deeper you go, the colder the things that live there.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.gloomsh: Depths where the light barely reaches. Cultists whisper in the dark, and the dead walk beside them.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.emberfo: Halls built around a forge that never cools. The knights who guard it were forged there too.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.crimson: The deepest gate a hunter can enter: a red abyss where blood runs through the stone. Few come back from it.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.rootbou: A beast's lair of packed earth, roots through the ceiling, and the bones of whatever it caught.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.mosswep: An old temple the moss took back. Green light falls through the cracks, and something still keeps its halls.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.sunscor: A buried tomb of sandstone and dust. The dead were laid to rest here, and not all of them stayed that way.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.bone_ca: Catacombs with bones in the walls and candles on the floor. The cold light comes from the souls still trapped here.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.chitin_: A nest of resin and mud, its cells full of glowing eggs. The hive hears every step you take.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.sunken_: A drowned temple of sea stone. Water runs down its halls, and its faithful never left.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.rimefro: Caverns of blue ice where snow falls without a sky. Here the cold is a hunter in its own right.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.crystal: An abandoned crystal mine. Amethyst glows in the walls, and the storm sleeping in the stone hums with every swing.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.sporefa: A cavern of giant mushrooms under a violet haze of spores. Breathe slowly.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.ironbou: A fortress keep of stone and timber, with red banners and a throne. Its garrison never stood down.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.stormsp: A tower of stone and green copper that hums with storm. Lightning finds whoever stands too tall.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.starles: Islands of pale stone adrift in a void without stars. Do not look down for long.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.inferna: A fortress of the burning dark, with lava in its channels and soul fire in its braziers.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.thresho: The sealed temple where the System first chose its player. The Arbiter waited here for whoever was worthy.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.red_wor: Behind a red gate lies a winter that never ends, under a red sky. The way back opens only when its master falls.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.crimson: A castle of a hundred floors, with a gatekeeper on every tenth and the Crimson King on the last.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.realms.penalty: Where the System sends whoever skips their training: a red desert with no shade and no way out but to survive.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.arsenal.hunter: What every new hunter is handed: light, sharp and quick to draw. Many famous hunters still carry their first.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.arsenal.knight: A knight's straight blade, balanced for the long fight rather than the first strike.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.arsenal.steel_: Heavy enough to split a shield, slow enough that you had better not miss.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.arsenal.huntin: A long spear that keeps a beast at the length of its shaft, where claws cannot reach.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.arsenal.emberb: Its blade never fully cools. Every cut it makes is a burn as well.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.arsenal.venom_: Forged around a venom gland of the hive: every strike leaves a little poison behind.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.arsenal.crimso: A curved reaper's blade that drinks the blood it spills, and grows hungrier for it.
chronicle.beyondsolo.lore.arsenal.bloodl: A narrow blade made to open wounds that will not close.
